events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Tavon Austin scored twice, Todd Gurley topped 1,000 yards rushing and the Rams beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 31-23 on Thursday night in what could be the franchise's final game in St. Louis.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams roll Bucs in possible last game in St. Louis

events.name: New York Jets at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: Randy Bullock kicked a 40-yard field goal with 36 seconds left and the Jets kept the pressure on Pittsburgh and Kansas City in the AFC wild-card race with a 19-16 victory over the Dallas.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets use late FG to top Cowboys, maintain pace

headlines.description: Brandon Weeden replaced injured quarterback T.J. Yates late in the first half and threw a go-ahead 8-yard TD pass to Jaelen Strong with 10:36 to play Sunday, giving Houston a 16-10 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Weeden leads Texans past Colts 16-10 for AFC South lead

headlines.description: Teddy Bridgewater threw a career-high four touchdowns and ran for another one, and the Minnesota Vikings took a significant step toward clinching a Playoff spot with a 38-17 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bridgewater totals 5 TDs; Vikings blow out Bears 38-17

events.name: Tennessee Titans at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for two TDs to help the New England Patriots hold onto the top spot in the AFC, beating Tennessee 33-16 on Sunday and knocking Titans QB Marcus Mariota out with a knee injury.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots hold top spot in AFC with 33-16 win over Titans

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New York Giants

headlines.description: Graham Gano's 43-yard field goal as time expired kept Carolina perfect this season with a wild 38-35 victory over the New York Giants on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers remain perfect, outlast Giants 38-35 in nasty game

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins equaled his career high with four touchdown passes and ran 13 yards for another score, helping the Washington Redskins win consecutive games for the first time in more than a year.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins' 4 TD passes lead Skins past eliminated Bills 35-25

headlines.description: Julio Jones scored for the first time in seven weeks, and the Atlanta Falcons ended a six-game losing streak with a 23-17 victory against the Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons beat Jaguars 23-17, end 6-game losing streak

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: The Kansas City Chiefs capitalized on a variety of miscues by the Baltimore Ravens and extended their winning streak to eight games with a 34-14 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs cruise past Ravens 34-14 for 8th straight victory

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw a touchdown pass and Damarious Randall returned an interception for another score to help the Green Bay Packers beat the Oakland Raiders 30-20 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers beat Raiders 30-20 after clinching playoffs

headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks clinch playoff berth with 30-13 win over Browns

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger passed for 380 yards and three touchdowns as the Steelers rallied for a 34-27 win over the Denver Broncos on Sunday.

events.name: Miami Dolphins at San Diego Chargers

headlines.shortLinkText: Woodhead scores 4 TDs in San Diego's possible NFL finale

headlines.shortLinkText: Bengals clinch 5th straight playoff berth with 24-14 win

headlines.description: The Arizona Cardinals can check division champions off their to-do list.
headlines.shortLinkText: Johnson runs for 3 TDs, Cardinals beat Eagles 40-17

events.name: Detroit Lions at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford passed for 254 yards and three touchdowns, and the Detroit Lions held off a late surge by New Orleans to defeat the Saints 35-27 on Monday night.
